about.title: About RepForge
about.heroDesc: RepForge is a personalized fitness platform designed to help users plan workouts, manage nutrition, track progress, discover suitable supplements, and find nearby gyms from one simple platform.
about.whyDesc: Fitness information is often scattered across different apps and websites. RepForge was created to bring essential fitness tools into one place and make fitness planning simple for everyone.
about.purposeHeadline: Built to help you achieve your goals effortlessly:
purposes: Find supplements according to their goal and budget
about.whatYouCanDo: What You Can Do With RepForge

features.fitnessPlanDesc: Enter your height, weight, and fitness goals to instantly receive a customized workout and diet strategy tailored for you.
features.workoutDesc: View structured daily routines, targeted exercises, sets, reps, and dynamic rest timers to maximize your training.
features.dietDesc: Track your daily meals with automated macro breakdowns for calories, protein, carbohydrates, and healthy fats.
features.progressDesc: Log and visualize body weight, completed workouts, hydration levels, daily calories, protein, and step counts over time.
features.aiCoachDesc: Get instant expert answers to your workout, diet, form, and recovery questions 24/7 through your AI fitness assistant.
features.supplementDesc: Filter supplements based on your goal, budget, and dietary preference (Veg/Non-Veg/Vegan) with total price transparency.
features.gymFinderDesc: Locate gyms around your current location using interactive maps, distance filters, ratings, and instant turn-by-turn directions.
features.dashboardDesc: Get a complete daily overview of your active streak, workout status, nutrition stats, and water progress in one unified view.

about.founderDesc: RepForge was created as a modern fitness technology project with the goal of making workout planning, nutrition guidance, supplement discovery, progress tracking and gym discovery easier from one platform.
about.founderSubDesc: Built with a focus on simple user experience, modern technology and practical fitness tools.
about.missionText: To make fitness planning simpler, more accessible and easier to understand by bringing useful fitness tools together in one modern platform.
